cat > /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.log"
CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029-seed4"
echo "$(date) Watchdog started for $CKPT_DIR" >> "$LOG"

while true; do
  if [ -d "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_10" ] && \
     [ -d "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_5" ]; then
    rm -rf "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_5"
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed4 step_5" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  if [ -d "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_15" ] && \
     [ -d "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_10" ]; then
    rm -rf "$CKPT_DIR/global_step_10"
    echo "$(date) Deleted seed4 step_10" >> "$LOG"
  fi

  sleep 60
done
SCRIPT

chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh
nohup bash /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoint_watchdog.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "Watchdog PID: $!"
ps aux | grep checkpoint_watchdog | grep -v grep
